name: app-zad-al-muslim-islamic-app-cover-green-with-prayer-beads
title: Zad Al-Muslim Islamic app cover in deep green with prayer beads and two phones
whatItIs: A dark green cover over a faded mosque interior with a large white Arabic calligraphic title, green prayer beads with a gold tassel, two phones (Quran page, home with prayer times and features), and pill tags 'Islamic App' and 'App Design'.
whatItMeans: Reverent and calm; deep green and the tasbih set a spiritual tone.
techniques: Use a culturally meaningful object as a prop.
Fade an architectural photo into the brand colour.
Let a large calligraphic title span the top.

vocabulary.definition: A heading written in decorative script.
